name: Feasibility
description: Feasibility aims to automate various aspects of urban and building layout design. By leveraging desktop-based platforms such as Dynamo and the web, it seeks to provide a flexible, efficient, and scalable way to design and manipulate parking layouts, erven (plot) layouts, and building massing in the future. The Dynamo package currently contains 12 nodes, primarily built out of Dynamo out-of-the-box nodes. The nodes automate the development of surface parking with various patterns and parameters to fine-tune the parking layouts. Using the feasibility parking workflow in combination with generative design is a powerful way of producing layouts that optimally use available space. The nodes do not contain any external packages and have been tested on Dynamo v 3.3.0 and Revit 2025.4.
contents: ExclusionZoneSpots - Create parking spots along the perimeter of the exclusion zones. , GenerateBoundingRectangle - Generates a rectangle around a planar closed curve, ensuring the curve is completely encapsulated. , GeneratePatterns - Creates the parking patterns., GeneratePerimeterSpots - Creates parking spots along the perimeter of the input boundary surface. , GetLevelPlane - Get the plane from a selected Revit level. , InternalandRoadwaySurfaces - Creates the internal parking and roadway surfaces. , InternalBays - Creates internal parking bays and allows the delineation of movement routes within the parking layout. , InternalBaysRoutes - Creates internal parking bays and allows the delineation of movement routes within the parking layout. , InternalBaysZones - Creates internal parking bays and allows the delineation of zones where parking will not be placed within the parking layout., InternalBaysZonesRoutes - Creates internal parking bays and allows the delineation of movement routes within the parking layout. , ProjectBoundaryOntoPlane - To project the boundaries developed from selected faces onto a plane. , ProjectRouteCurvesOntoPlane - To project selected route curves onto a Revit plane.
